source: Generated from the Yano X repository at documentation build time.

recipes.name: Replicated audit log
recipes.description: A replicated append-only log for opaque application records.
recipes.primaryOutcome: One opaque record is threshold-finalized in the shared application order.
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using only built-in packaged runtime capabilities.

recipes.name: Owned registry
recipes.description: A first-writer-owned key/value registry with committed query proofs.
recipes.primaryOutcome: The first writer owns a named value that is readable with a committed state proof.
recipes.verificationQuery: state/proof/{hex(key)} decodes to owner and value
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using the bundled standard-library registry.

recipes.name: Authenticated map
recipes.description: A proof-oriented multi-collection registry with optional canonical-CBOR and declarative schema validation.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A value accepted under a genesis-declared collection schema is committed and available with a state proof.
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe whose collection, encoding, schema, and commitment identities are frozen in canonical genesis.

recipes.name: Threshold approval workflow
recipes.description: Validator members propose, approve, reject, and prove terminal decisions.
recipes.primaryOutcome: Distinct validator-member decisions produce a provable terminal approval or rejection.
recipes.verificationQuery: state/proof/{hex(i/itemId)} decodes to the decision trail
recipes.trustStatement: First-party Yano recipe using the bundled generic approval state machine.

recipes.name: Governed role approvals
recipes.description: Governed organizations, actors, and policies approve arbitrary application payload hashes.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A governed role policy accepts valid actor decisions and rejects an ineligible actor decision.
recipes.firstCommand: apply the generated role bootstrap plan, then submit a signed proposal
recipes.verificationQuery: plugin role-workflow proposals/{id} plus returned proof key
recipes.trustStatement: First-party generic role product; applications retain responsibility for acting on an approved payload hash.

recipes.name: Role-aware evidence ledger
recipes.description: A role-aware evidence ledger that emits publication intents; add and provision explicit connector capabilities for external mutation.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A role-authorized evidence record and its release decision are committed and queryable.
recipes.firstCommand: apply the generated role bootstrap plan, then submit evidence and a signed release proposal
recipes.trustStatement: First-party preview evidence profile; it records and authorizes evidence claims but does not prove real-world truth or external publication by itself.

recipes.name: Scalus-backed EUTxO ledger
recipes.description: A deterministic Cardano-shaped test ledger funded by an explicit virtual genesis allocation.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A signed key-controlled or bounded Plutus V3 transaction consumes virtual EUTxOs and creates MPF-proven outputs and receipts.
recipes.trustStatement: Experimental no-real-funds recipe; bounded Plutus V3 execution does not make it a Cardano bridge, custody product, or rollup.

recipes.name: Federated Cardano EUTxO bridge
recipes.description: A Cardano-backed EUTxO ledger with stable deposits and claim-bound federated withdrawals through external signing or permissionless current-root proofs.
recipes.primaryOutcome: Accepted stable deposits create mirrored EUTxOs; signed L2 spends create irrevocable claims that settle only through the configured signer path or a current accepted MPF root with single-use nullification.
recipes.firstCommand: stage and accept a bounded deposit, then submit a signed withdrawal output carrying the bridge withdrawal datum
recipes.verificationQuery: query bridge/deposits/record, bridge/withdrawals/record, bridge/reserve, and the root-fixed withdrawal commitment proof through appchain-eutxo-client
recipes.trustStatement: Experimental real-funds federated custody path. Use only reviewed contract identities and bridge/root operators. Signer mode trusts an external threshold/HSM; proof mode trusts the threshold-accepted root. Virtual genesis and ZeroJ are deliberately excluded.

recipes.name: ZeroJ EUTxO validity development profile
recipes.description: A no-real-funds EUTxO ledger with the optional ZeroJ validity commitment and the interfaces needed to operate and test direct proof settlement.
recipes.primaryOutcome: Bounded finalized EUTxO payments deterministically update both the Yano MPF root and the circuit-friendly validity root and can be proved against pinned development artifacts.
recipes.firstCommand: submit a bounded key-payment batch, then run the separately provisioned prover and permissionless settlement relay
recipes.verificationQuery: query the EUTxO validity-root record and compare it with the proof statement and L1 root datum
recipes.trustStatement: Development/testnet recipe with virtual value and a restricted bounded-payment circuit. It is not production-funds ready, not a general Plutus prover, and not entitled to the rollup label.

recipes.name: ZeroJ EUTxO testnet lifecycle
recipes.description: Packages the Cardano-shaped L2 client, measured b16 development circuit, durable lifecycle tooling, contract plans, prover artifacts, relay handoff, and recovery evidence as one JVM-only testnet project.
recipes.primaryOutcome: A project can bootstrap pinned development artifacts, accept finalized Jubjub-authorized L2 transactions, produce a constant-size proof, and prepare idempotent Cardano deposit, settlement, withdrawal, and recovery operations.
recipes.trustStatement: Testnet lifecycle for zeroj-jubjub-dev-v1. It requires a trusted prover, permits disposable test funds only, rejects mainnet, and does not claim malicious-prover security or production rollup readiness.

recipes.name: Custom state-machine project
recipes.description: A generated project boundary for a separately reviewed custom state-machine plugin.
recipes.primaryOutcome: The operator-defined state-machine contract is loaded from a reviewed pinned plugin bundle.
recipes.firstCommand: install the reviewed bundle and submit its documented command
recipes.verificationQuery: plugin-defined committed query or state proof
recipes.trustStatement: Advanced JVM-only path; the operator owns plugin implementation, code review, metadata trust, compatibility, and distribution.

capabilities.name: Federated Cardano EUTxO bridge

capabilities.name: ZeroJ EUTxO validity settlement
capabilities.description: Adds a Yano L2 envelope with a Cardano-compatible body, registered Jubjub session-key authorization, optional Poseidon validity commitment, durable proving interfaces, proof-bound Cardano root advancement, bounded aggregate withdrawal and canonical L1 batch publication.

capabilities.name: EUTxO lifecycle indexer

capabilities.description: Pins the initial member set as the active set.

capabilities.name: Governed membership
capabilities.description: Allows authenticated member epochs to evolve through replicated governance.

capabilities.name: L1 slot feed
capabilities.description: Supplies stable local Cardano slot observations to slot-aware app-chain behavior.

capabilities.name: Cardano metadata anchors

capabilities.name: Cardano threshold-script anchors

capabilities.name: Kafka finalized sink
capabilities.description: Publishes finalized application blocks to a configured Kafka topic.

capabilities.name: IPFS pin executor

capabilities.name: Cardano payment executor
capabilities.description: Executes bounded cardano.payment intents from an operator-controlled payer wallet.

capabilities.name: Composite state-machine framework

capabilities.description: Optional one-command durable metrics history for the unified console.
